statement: Under equal parameter budget (~9.35M) at 50 steps / seq_len=64, Dense Transformer achieves loss 1.3664 vs IVERI Full 3.1425 (13016 vs 173 tok/s). AT SAME WALL-CLOCK TIME Dense trains ~75× more steps. This gap is attributable to: (a) IVERI architectural overhead at short sequence, (b) MoR gradient instability increasing effective loss during early training. This does NOT imply Dense is better for long-context tasks (MISSING-002).
interpretation_warning: Compute-controlled comparison required for fair conclusion. Step-controlled comparison disadvantages IVERI 75×.
